trained_on: LibreYOLO/weed-crop-aerial (CC BY 4.0) -- credit Roboflow 100 / Roboflow Universe
decode: raw head; decode + NMS on host via agri_edge.inference.yolox
validation_notes: NOT aerial despite the name: ground-level close-ups plus indoor propagation trays, and 98.3% of `crop` labels come from the trays. Effectively a seedling detector at ~30-80 cm range. Class balance 95% weed / 5% crop. NOT validated on Canadian field imagery. Decision support only.
